questions.stem_text:
Mulholland (1998) argued that privatization changed the relationship between companies and
managers in that:

options.A: flexibility was reduced by the introduction of detailed daily worksheets
options.B: the state had greater control than managers over production processes
options.C: ownership was transferred from small shareholders to senior managers
options.D: employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment

questions.stem_text:
Economic aid has largely failed to promote modernization in the developing countries
because:

options.A: there are no clearly defined projects into which the money can be directed
options.B: the United Nations has refused to call on rich countries to provide it
options.C: debt repayments with interest can be greater than the amount of money received
options.D: debt repayments with interest can be greater than the amount of money received

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - debt repayments with interest can be greater than the amount of money received

questions.stem_text: In modern societies, social status is typically measured by a person's:

options.A: ways of acting, thinking, and feeling that are collective and social in origin
options.B: the way scientists construct knowledge in a social context
options.C: data collected about social phenomena that are proven to be correct
options.D: ideas and theories that have no basis in the external, physical world

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - ways of acting, thinking, and feeling that are collective and social in origin
